intro: Finding the Shadowy Figure is an Alliance quest that tasks adventurers with tracking down an elusive stranger connected to the tragedy at Sven Yorgen's farm. Guided by clues from Tavernkeep Smitts in Darkshire, travelers scour the haunted woods to the west in search of the fleeing fugitive.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Good luck, friend. I hope you find the chap, and I hope you find him alive.
If he's left the safety of Darkshire then he could be prey to the beasts of the wilds.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Who are you?? Leave me be!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, I'm the author of that book. You finally found me, eh?
Well if you read that journal...then you only know the half of it!
